start_gateway_run_gateway: start the Hermes messaging gateway with configured platform adapters and run until interrupted
run_gateway_with_config: run the Hermes gateway using a custom GatewayConfig object for platform and session settings
create_gateway_runner_instance: create a GatewayRunner instance to manage the full gateway lifecycle including adapters and sessions
build_gateway_start_adapters: build and start all configured messaging platform adapters in the Hermes gateway
run_gateway_handle_message: run the core message handling pipeline that processes incoming messages from messaging platforms
